question: Predict how the colour of the sky would change if the Earth had no atmosphere. Justify your answer.

options.A: The sky would remain blue because blue light can scatter without air molecules.
options.B: The sky would become red because red light is scattered most strongly in vacuum.
options.C: The sky would appear white because all colours travel equally fast in vacuum.
options.D: Without an atmosphere there would be no air molecules to scatter sunlight. Since the blue sky is due to scattering of shorter wavelengths, the sky would appear dark or black, as seen from outer space.
